facts.fact: Nile Post reports that NIRA's mandate covers registration and identification of citizens and resident foreigners as well as civil registration of births, deaths, adoptions, guardianship orders and marriages, so one body holds both.

systems.owner: NIRA, under the Ministry of Internal Affairs

facts.fact: Figures presented at NIRA's expo and cited by Minister Kamuntu put about 36.2 million Ugandans identified, approximately 78.8% of the population, which is over a third.
